store.description: The infamous physics ragdoll game. Pick a rider and a vehicle, then throw yourself down the track and try to reach the finish with as much of yourself intact as possible.
features: Physics ragdoll carnage with vehicles and traps
Arrow keys to accelerate and lean, Space to eject
Hundreds of obstacle courses built to hurt
Embedded client — no download, no account
Reload and Open-in-Browser toolbar if the frame is blocked
